How much is a used Air Jordan 1 worth?

Air Jordan 1 prices depend first on the cut: High, Mid or Low. A Mid that looks like a famous High sells for a fraction of it.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The style code on the size label identifies the cut and colourway. Highs have more lace holes than Mids, and the Mid has a different collar. Search the code to compare.

What decides the price

  • Cut: Highs above Lows and Mids.
  • Colourway: limited releases and collaborations far above general releases.
  • Condition: creasing, sole wear, scuffs.
  • Authenticity: fakes are common.

Check before you buy

  • Match the style code on the shoe and box.
  • Check the stitching, the logo and the shape against verified pairs.
  • Look for heel and sole wear.

Where it sells best

Sells on eBay and Vinted; valuable pairs on authenticated platforms.

Today's price

Prices for a used Air Jordan 1 change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers. Questions

How much is a used Air Jordan 1 worth?

It depends on High, Mid or Low, colourway, size and condition. Prices change weekly, so check today's value: type "Nike Air Jordan 1" and the condition into FlipLens (fliplens.eu), which compares current eBay listings in the UK and five EU countries and shows the expected sale price and the most worth paying.

Why are Jordan 1 Mids cheaper than Highs?

They are a general-release line with less demand. The cut matters more than the colourway for most pairs.

How do I know if my Jordan 1s are worth a lot?

Search the style code. Limited releases and collaborations are worth far more than general releases.
